_note: Community-submitted, UNTESTED factory images for the badge. Each is served same-origin from community/firmware/ and flashed at 0x0. These are NOT hardware-verified by Retia — the site warns and gates every flash. Added by pull request; a maintainer validates with the catbadge-community-image skill. Schema per image: { id, name, author, source, desc, file, url, addr, sha256, submitted }.

images.name: Pusheen Danza
images.author: skickar
images.desc: A dancing Pusheen fills the screen while the Danza Kuduro horn hook plays on the piezo (transcribed from audio); a rainbow wave flows across the ear NeoPixels and the SAO LED flashes on the beat. Press A to mute. Display/LED/audio only — no radio, no TX. No SD card needed.

images.name: bleuje loops
images.author: Retia (animations: Etienne Jacob, with permission)
images.desc: Fullscreen gallery of Etienne Jacob (bleuje)'s perfect-loop generative animations, with on-badge curation (A keep / B cut, hold BOOT to purge). Needs an SD card with GIFs in /gifs — grab the ready-made 204-loop gallery pack (included with the artist's permission) and conversion recipes at the source link. Display/SD only — no radio, no TX. Boots to a 20s credits page.

images.name: Pocket Server
images.author: skickar
images.desc: Turns the badge into a self-contained Wi-Fi file server and web host: it broadcasts its own access point, and any phone or laptop that joins can browse, upload and download files or open a hosted page — no internet needed. The TFT shows the network name, password and a QR code that joins the Wi-Fi when scanned, then points you at the portal. Serves from a FAT microSD, or internal flash if no card is present. Display / Wi-Fi / SD only — no radio, no TX. Note: SD-over-SPI on the badge's shared display bus is code-complete but not yet confirmed with a card in the badge; the portal itself loads either way.
